//: Production-only configuration. Loaded automatically when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production (the default in Azure App Service). Every value below is meant to be set via App Service Configuration / Key Vault references, NOT committed with real secrets. This file is the schema, not the values.

ConnectionStrings.//: Azure SQL Database connection string. Set via App Service Configuration > Connection strings > DefaultConnection. Recommended form: Server=tcp:<server>.database.windows.net,1433;Initial Catalog=<db>;Encrypt=True;Authentication=Active Directory Default; — uses managed identity so no password lives in config.

//1: Public URLs for the deployed apps. Set via env vars Sso__PublicUrl and Sso__PhosphonetPublicUrl on the App Service so a code change is never needed to switch domains.
//2: Real X.509 signing + encryption certificates. Mount via Azure Key Vault or upload to App Service > TLS/SSL settings > Private Key Certificates and reference the path under D:\home\site\wwwroot\... or similar. Without these, OpenIddictExtensions.cs throws on startup in non-Development environments.
//3: Registered SSO client apps. Each ClientSecret should come from Key Vault. The RedirectUris must match the deployed Phosphonet's https domain exactly — wildcards are NOT allowed.
//4: SMTP for email confirmation. Azure Communication Services or SendGrid are the standard choices.
